messages:
Sam W: PTAL — addressed async queue ordering bug that caused rare reorders under high QPS. Added unit + smoke tests. tl;dr: fixed CAS logic in shard queue, added e2e with a small load generator. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321

Maria T: thanks — quick q: did you keep the original backoff behavior? iirc we relied on ordering to avoid duplicates.

Sam W: yes, preserved backoff semantics. changed only the CAS loop. added a comment explaining the approach. diff excerpt: ```diff
- if (!queue.head.compareAndSet(old, new)) return retry();
+ while (!queue.head.compareAndSet(old, new)) { old = queue.head.get(); }
```

Alex K: lgtm from me. ran the smoke locally — looks solid. two tiny nits: add a brief changelog line and a test for the empty-queue path.

Sam W: added changelog line + empty-queue test in a followup commit, pushed. ptal again when you have ~10m.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for branch fix/queue-ordering (build 8792) :white_check_mark:

Maria T: left one inline comment re: log level (should be debug for that rare branch). otherwise looks good. squash or keep history?

Sam W: squashed the fix + tests into one commit, kept changelog as a separate commit per release guidelines. if no other objections, can we schedule merge tonight during the 9pm PT window? @Alex K :clock9: :thumbsup:

Alex K: ok for me. i'll take merge custody tonight at 9pm PT and monitor canary. add rollback notes to the PR description and tag ops.

Sam W: thanks! assigning merge to Alex and added a short canary checklist to the ops runbook section for this PR. :pray:
